verdict: Ads are off this period; GBP and site traffic are holding the line.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at $0 spend across the full 28-day window, so there are no paid leads, purchases, or return-on-ad-spend figures to report this period — this is a confirmed pause, not a data issue. Your Google Business Profile picked up the slack for most of the period, generating 413 total actions including 44 calls and 87 direction requests, though GBP engagement dropped sharply in the last 7 days and recorded zero activity on each of the final three days (Aug 28–30), which is being looked into now. Website sessions remained active at 7,316 this period, though they softened modestly toward the end of the window with no paid traffic to support them. Ads are being relaunched — the funnel test is closed and tracking is going live today — so paid performance data will return in next week's report.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period, including 44 calls and 87 direction requests
website sessions this period, holding steady despite zero paid traffic
drop in GBP engagement over the last 7 days, with zero activity on the final three days

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement fell to zero over the last three days of the period, pointing to a possible listing or local visibility issue.
watch_item.fix: The GBP listing is being audited this week to identify and correct the cause before it affects call and direction volume further.
